usedFor: HeyGen reports a failed translation with “Translate Video Fail”, and Asana receives the follow-up through “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “Translate Video Fail” in HeyGen, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A failed video translation becomes an Asana task with an assignee and dates, so nobody watches HeyGen.

watchOut: “Translate Video Fail” only fires on failures, so a translation that finishes never creates a task.
